text: Entry Requirements 1.International students must hold foreign nationality. 2.Chinese students immigrants to foreign countries, one or both their parents of Chinese citizens and settled in foreign countries, the student was born with a foreign nationality, must hold a valid passport or foreign nationality certificate 4 years (including) and above, the docutment to prove that in the past four years (deadline for application isb April 30 of the same year), the student actual living abroad for more than two years. 3.Bachelor degree. 4.Not exceeding 35. 5.TOEFL 80.
